run_killall_cleanup: run killall.py to clean up orphaned SGLang processes on GPUs before CI jobs
run_killall_verify_gpus: run killall.py and verify GPUs are clean after cleanup completes
run_killall_check_gpus: run killall.py to check GPU memory usage and list processes using target GPUs
run_killall_find_processes: run killall.py to find SGLang PIDs by command-line pattern matching in /proc
run_killall_kill_targets: run killall.py to kill SGLang processes, orchestrator ancestors, and GPU-bound processes
